brief:
Belgium's top universities condemned the government's refusal to help 13 scholarship recipients from Gaza reach the country, Middle East Eye reported. The students had received scholarships to study at Belgian institutions but remain unable to travel due to the ongoing conflict.

The universities did not specify what assistance they had requested or what grounds the government cited for its decision. The status of the students and whether alternative arrangements have been explored remained unclear.
dek: Universities slam Belgian refusal to evacuate Gaza students Belgium's top universities condemned on Monday the government's refusal to help 13 students from war-torn Gaza, who received scholarships at Belgian universities, reach the country.
title: Belgian universities condemn government refusal to evacuate Gaza students
